title: Welcome to the CCMS project.
summary: CCMS (Cloud Customer Management System), a Business Central app for managing online customers at scale, has been released as an open-source project under the Directions for Partners umbrella. Its repo has accepted contributions since 11 December 2025. The post also promotes YAMPI, a separate MCP server for AI-assisted tenant administration from developer tools. Both tools are free.
key_points: CCMS is a customer management application for Business Central now released as open source on GitHub
YAMPI is an MCP server enabling AI-assisted Business Central tenant administration from developer tools
Both tools are free and open to community contributions and suggestions
The tools make complex administrative tasks more accessible and can save significant time

quotes.text: These are tools that can save hours of time on doing administrative tasks (and not only) for your Business Central customers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical value proposition of CCMS and YAMPI for Business Central administrators managing multiple customers

quotes.text: Everything IS and STILL be FREE! And with your suggestions we can improve them always more…
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the project's commitment to remaining free and community-driven, inviting continuous improvement through collaboration
